text_block_list.text: The new year. As I headed to the shrine to pay my respects—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup, here you go☆
It's nice and warm, and super buono~!

Hishi Akebono was handing out sweet amazake
alongside the local shopping district folks.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's Trainer~!
Happy New Yeeeear!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know, the shopping district was asking for
volunteers, so I decided to join in~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make a whole bunch of amazake
and hand it out to everyone~.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
She's been a huge help.
Buono-chan is so strong, after all.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text: Suggesting that we prepare things other than amazake was Buono-chan's idea too, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text: More people than usual took one.It really does make me happy, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
I got praised~.

"Sure enough, looking closely, there was also coffee
and hot chocolate prepared alongside the amazake."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I was trying to think of something that could warm up people who don't like amazake~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I'd love for you to grab
a drink you like too, Trainer~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Which one would be good?
Amazake is packed with vitamins and rich in nutrients—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
This coffee was made with beans from the shopping district's café.
It totally motivates me to do my best in everything♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'd recommend the hot chocolate too~. It has this really special, wonderful flavor to it~.
choice_data_list: With coffee, I can power through anything!
Hot chocolate for a special power boost!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Got it~!
It makes me feel so warm inside, right from my tummy~.

The amazake she handed me was delicious,
with a deep sweetness
and a thick, velvety texture!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
We prepped everything together starting yesterday.
It was so much fun~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! And then, we started
talking about you, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! They're a really important person to me,
kind, reliable, and—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
"I heard they always eat their meals
with such great appetite, you know!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text:
Heeey~! Bono-chan was talking about
how fun it is to cook for her Trainer, too, so... you know~!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text: It's been so long since I heard such an exciting story that I got carried away! I'm so sorry~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it was like, everyone was
going wild together and it was so much fun~.

In any case, it seemed she had a fun day
together with everyone from the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Okee-doke~♪
Would you like sugar and milk with that~?

I tell them how I'd like my sugar and milk,
and receive the warm coffee.

It was a truly delicious coffee,
characterized by its deep aroma and rich flavor.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Phew, good! I absolutely
love that coffee, too~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I bought some coffee beans too.
Let's drink it together with some cake next time~.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me,
could I get one cup of amazake?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ah, okaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Is that... Bono-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right~
Oh, wait, could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor
text_block_list.text:
I'm a big fan~! I thought you looked like her,
but I never imagined you'd actually be the real deal~!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor
text_block_list.text:
I was totally blown away by her powerful, jaw-dropping race!
I couldn't believe an Umamusume like that even existed—she completely stole my heart!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor
text_block_list.text: I'm really looking forward to facing Biko in the next Takamatsunomiya Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm happy, but kinda embarrassed too~.
Thanks, I'll do my best~!
Afterward, the shrine visitor took the amazake and walked away with a big smile, waving enthusiastically.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hot chocolate? My, Trainer, you certainly have good taste~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Careful your cheeks don't fall off from how delicious it is~. Hehe.

She handed me the hot chocolate.
Its rich, distinctive flavor was absolutely delicious.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
I love it so much too~!
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh!? It's Bono and Bono's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Biko-chan!
Happy New Year~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Congrats!
Whatcha up to?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'm handing out hot drinks~.
Do you want something to drink too, Biko-chan~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh!
Ah, in that case, hot chocolate—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no good! I'm in a rush right now!
There's a New Year's hero special on today, you see!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa now!
Can't afford to miss that~

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
I just rushed over here real quick to pray!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So sorry, and thanks!
Do your best, Bono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
See you later~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder what Biko-chan wished for~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'd be super happy if you'd
pray for me at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, by the way,
have you done your shrine visit yet, Trainer~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Do you mind if I come along for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking it'd be nice to do a
'Let's do our best!' together with you, Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm free right now
and doing fine, so go right ahead!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~!
I'll be right back!

And so, hurrying a little,
we joined the queue to pray—
(Clap-clap)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Our prayer is obviously *that*, right~
Trainer☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
May the two of us do our very best in
the Takamatsunomiya Kinen... and the races after it too~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, whenever I pray at a shrine, I somehow
feel power welling up~. Like *pow-pow-power*~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do my best this year too~!
Let's give it our all, Trainer!

—And that cheerful vibe kicked off New Year's Day.
Looks like this year's gonna be a great one, too!
